text:
Dina: quick sprint handshake — where are we on the kernel perf PRs + KV warmup fixes?
Owen: kernel PRs are merged (4823, 4831). I didn't flip the runtime flag b/c wanted an approval from maya.
Maya: saw 4831, had one nits comment about the seq-len path. I'll approve once qbench repros clean.
Dina: ok, can we get a canary run with continuous-batching + kv-warmup? need numbers for the mid-sprint report.
Owen: will trigger after maya approves. heads-up: the new ABI change needs eng-platform schema bump — Cal, that's on your plate, right?
Cal: yep I have the schema PR open (plat-910). planning to merge after smoke tests. ETA 2h.
Priya: fyi support noticed a few customer timeouts yesterday that map to cold-hot transitions — sounds related to kv eviction heuristics.
Maya: that matches my qbench failures (cold start amplified by cache miss storm). working on a deterministic repro.
Dina: priority: 1) get canary numbers with continuous batching + kv warmup; 2) confirm kernel flag flip; 3) track eng-platform schema merge. owners?
Owen: owner for (1) + (2) is me, but need maya to green light (qbench).
Maya: owner for repro + approval (qbench -> green) is me, target in 3h.
Cal: owner for schema merge is me, will post link when merged: https://git.company/plat/pulls/910
Dina: great. once canary runs, please paste perf summary (p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec) and include the command used.
Owen: will run: 
```bash
perf-run --env canary --conf batching=continuous --kv-warmup=true --suite=qbench
```
Owen: launching now. tagging infra-bot to watch for deploy issues. @infra-bot can you watch the canary and ping if >2% error spike?
infra-bot: Deploy Canary started for runtime-canary-eu-west at 1718010200. Auto-rollback threshold: 2% error increase.
Priya: capturing logs from the customer incidents, I'll attach traces to the ticket. might help tune eviction thresholds.
Dina: if canary looks good, we'll flip the flag in next deploy window and update the rollout spreadsheet.
Maya: qbench reproducer fixed a race (seq-len default mismatch) — re-running now, expect green in ~20m.
Owen: perf run started (job 8921). I'll post partial metrics once warmup finishes.
Cal: merged plat-910. link: https://git.company/plat/commit/3f2a1e — please pull before running platform-integration tests.
Dina: excellent. blockers?
Maya: just the repro run; if that fails again I'll need help debugging the seq padding path.
Owen: if maya flags anything, I'll pair for 30m.
Priya: I'll correlate customer traces and post a summary in the ticket by EOD.
Dina: thanks — I'll update the sprint board: set milestone to "canary metrics + schema merge" and mark owners. :thumbsup:
Owen: ping me here when qbench passes and I'll paste p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec.
Maya: qbench green. results: p50 18ms, p95 86ms, p99 210ms, tokens/sec +12% vs baseline. posting artifacts in the run.
Owen: canary stable for 17m, error rate -0.1% vs baseline, traffic steady. p50/p95/p99 match maya's numbers.
Dina: perfect. I'll schedule the flag flip for the 2pm deploy window and notify CS.
Cal: noted — platform tests passed on main after merge.
Priya: will follow up on the customer incident ticket with mitigations.
Dina: thanks all. small follow-ups: (a) Owen to add a short README for the runtime flag flip steps, (b) Maya to open a small test that covers the seq-len padding, (c) Priya to attach customer traces to the incident.
Owen: will do (README in runtime repo).
Maya: opening test now (PR 4870).
Priya: attaching traces to ticket INC-2145.
Dina: closing the loop here — reach out if anything regresses during rollout. :raised_hands:
